# cubepath_firewall_group (Resource)

Manages a firewall group with reusable firewall rules for VPS instances.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the firewall group.
- `project_id` (Number) The ID of the project this firewall group belongs to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the firewall group is enabled.
- `rule` (Block List) Firewall rules in this group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the firewall group.
- `vps_count` (Number) Number of VPS instances using this firewall group.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `direction` (String) Direction of traffic: 'in' for incoming, 'out' for outgoing.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: 'tcp', 'udp', 'icmp', or 'gre'.

Optional:

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this rule.
- `port` (String) Port specification (e.g., '80', '80-443', '80,443,8080'). Optional for icmp/gre.
- `source` (String) Source IP or CIDR (e.g., '0.0.0.0/0', '10.0.0.0/24'). Defaults to any if not specified.
